title: Calendar-spread momentum in commodities (front minus second contract)
universe: CL, NG, HO, RB, ZC, ZS, LE, HE
rule: spread return s = r_front - r_second (roll-safe front; second contract returns only between bars of the same contract); signal = sign of the L-day sum of s (known at the close), held from the next day; size 0.10 / annualised 60-day spread vol / 8 per market; costs: both legs per unit turnover (cost_frac front + cost_frac second) and both legs again on front roll days
judgement: EQR book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.240
